# PS7000 read-only Modbus register map

**Protocol:** Modbus RTU, slave  
**Function code:** 0x04 (read input registers)  
**Scope:** Read-only registers (function code 0x04). Configuration and control writes are covered by the official Modbus manual supplied with the instrument.

## Before you read a single register

1. **Register numbers here are 1-based. The start address placed in the request frame is register number MINUS ONE.** To read register 1026, put 1025 (0x0401) in the frame.
2. **Word order for 32-bit values is CDAB - low word first, then high word.** Most Modbus masters default to ABCD. Set word order to 'little' / 'swapped' or floats will decode as nonsense.
3. Serial defaults: 8-N-1, slave 1-247, default 1 (0 = broadcast, no reply), baud 9600 / 19200 / 38400 / 57600 / 115200.

> Register numbers below are stable from SW 3.3.26 onward. The measurement block is append-only: newer firmware adds fields at the end and never moves an existing one.

## Legacy main value

| Register | Field | Type | Unit | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mainValue` | U16 | see mainValueUnit (x0.001) | Filtered main value multiplied by 1000, truncated to an integer. Kept for legacy masters that can only read one register. Prefer register 1026, which is a float and does not clip. |

## Identification

| Register | Field | Type | Unit | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 800 | `swVersionMajor` | U16 |  | Firmware version, major |
| 801 | `swVersionMinor` | U16 |  | Firmware version, minor |
| 802 | `swVersionPatch` | U16 |  | Firmware version, patch |
| 803 | `hwVersionMajor` | U16 |  | Hardware version, major |
| 804 | `hwVersionMinor` | U16 |  | Hardware version, minor |
| 805 | `deviceType` | U16 |  | Device identity, self-reported. 0x50 = density / concentration meter, 0x51 = spectral concentration meter. Firmware older than this feature answers exception 02; treat that as 'type unknown' rather than as an error. |

## Measurement result block

The whole block can be read in one request. Function code 0x04 allows 125 registers per request, so read 1000-1086 (87 registers) in one go, or request individual fields.

| Register | Field | Type | Unit | Description |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1000 | `moduleStatus` | U32 |  | Module status bit flags, see docs/error-codes.md |
| 1002 | `wires` | U16 |  | Hardware wire count. Not used, ignore. |
| 1003 | `initProgress` | U16 | % | Power-on initialisation progress, 0-100 |
| 1004 | `measureErrorCode` | U16 |  | Measurement error bits, 0 = OK. See docs/error-codes.md. THIS is the field that tells you whether the reading is fresh. |
| 1005 | `systemErrorCode` | U16 |  | System error bits, 0 = OK |
| 1006 | `signalStrength` | U16 |  | Echo signal strength |
| 1007 | `signalQuality` | F32 |  | Signal quality, 0.0-1.0 |
| 1009 | `currentCalibrationDataNo` | U16 |  | Active calibration data set number |
| 1010 | `currentCalibrationMethod` | U16 |  | Active calibration method |
| 1011 | `energyVoltage` | F32 | mV | Raw energy voltage |

| 1104 | `gasIndex` | U16 |  | Entrained-gas index, 0-100. 0 = no gas detected. Instantaneous value - a single bubble crossing the beam can spike it. Derived from frame-to-frame variance, not from absolute echo amplitude, which is what lets it separate 'more bubbles' from 'more solids'. _(firmware SW 4.x)_ |
| 1113 | `gasIndexEma` | U16 |  | Time-smoothed entrained-gas index. This is the one to alarm on: it ignores isolated bubbles and responds to sustained gas. The instrument's own bubble flag is driven by this value exceeding its threshold for consecutive cycles. _(firmware SW 4.x)_ |
